record_type_quote: In this study, we approximately replicated Papi and Khajavy’s (2021) investigation into the regulatory focus in second language acquisition, applying their approach to a significantly larger cohort of 855 Chinese second language (L2) learners.

targets.title: Motivational mechanisms underlying second language achievement: A regulatory focus perspective
targets.evidence_quote: In this study, we approximately replicated Papi and Khajavy’s (2021) investigation into the regulatory focus in second language acquisition, applying their approach to a significantly larger cohort of 855 Chinese second language (L2) learners.
targets.outcome_quote: To conclude, the results of Ideal L2 Self/Own in the second layer agree with those of Papi and Khajavy (2021); however, the predictive power of ought selves did not show the same consistency.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly describe agreement in ideal-self paths and inconsistency in ought-self paths, and additional paths not completely aligning. General support statements concern selected layers, not an unqualified overall replication verdict.

reasoning: Single new Chinese sample explicitly replicates Papi and Khajavy (2021); Papi et al. (2019) is the model background rather than a separate retested original.
